F (VI) - Dark submediant chord locking the progression into natural minor
Bm (Bridge Tonic) - Unexpected key shift that creates the feeling of drifting into dreamlike surrender

techniques.name: Thumb-Over Bass Inversions & Acoustic Dynamics
techniques.description: Fretting the low F# bass note on the 2nd fret of the 6th string with the thumb while holding an open D triad, creating smooth stepwise bass descent

notes: D/F# chord: 2-X-0-2-3-2 (thumb on 2nd fret low E, mute A string, open D, fretted G/B/E)
Verse acoustic walkdown: Am → D/F# → Em → G
Bridge picking pattern: Arpeggiated Bm, D, and C voicings
sequence: Strum Am with steady down-up eighth note groove
Wrap thumb over to catch 2nd fret on the low E string for D/F#
Transition smoothly to open Em and full G major
Swell into the chorus with heavier right-hand pick attack
tips: Keep your thumb relaxed when wrapping around the neck—don't squeeze the fretboard
In the bridge, Jonny Greenwood generates the space-age roar using a Roland Space Echo pedal driven into self-oscillation
Thom Yorke composed this acoustic rhythm bed inspired by The Beatles' 'Sexy Sadie'

beginner.title: Verse Open Chords

Practice steady down-up eighth note strumming at 75 BPM
Substitute standard D for D/F# while building finger flexibility

intermediate.title: Thumb-Over D/F# & Bridge
steps: Master wrapping your thumb around the neck to cleanly fret the 2nd fret low E (F#)
Learn the B minor barre chord progression in the bridge
Play smoothly through the verse, chorus, and bridge without rhythmic hesitation

advanced.title: Electric Texture & Ambient Delay
steps: Incorporate Jonny Greenwood's electric arpeggios and delay feedback swells
Control the dynamic arc from intimate acoustic verse to roaring stadium outro
Replicate the authentic OK Computer tape-echo ambiance live

Playing too aggressively in the verse instead of saving power for the outro
